overview_description.description: CratD2C Decentralized Autonomous SmartChain is a blockchain and cryptocurrency project that describes itself as a decentralized smart-chain platform for digital commerce, decentralized applications, and blockchain-based financial services. The platform is associated with the CRAT token and promotes services related to staking, token sales, and blockchain infrastructure. The platform states that it supports multiple sectors including e-commerce, payment systems, finance, tourism, hospitality, and real estate through blockchain infrastructure and smart contract technology. The project also promotes token sale campaigns, staking programs, and decentralized finance-related use cases.

product.name: CratD2C Smart Chain
product.description: A Layer-1 blockchain platform utilizing Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS) consensus to provide high security, instant transaction finality, and scalability with up to 100,000 transactions per second.

product.name: Validators
product.description: Participants who validate transactions and produce new blocks, earning rewards from block rewards and transaction fees.

product.name: Delegators
product.description: Participants who delegate their staking power to validators, earning a portion of the block rewards and transaction fees.

product.name: LiteBackers
product.description: Supporters who stake a minimum of 200,000 CratD2C Coins, earning 17% APR and potential biannual royalty returns.

product.name: TurboBackers
product.description: Contributors who stake a minimum of 300,000 CratD2C Coins, earning 20% APR and potential biannual royalty returns.

product.name: e-Commerce Trading Portal
product.description: A decentralized platform for direct business-to-consumer transactions, enhancing transparency and reducing costs.
